text:
ryan: Low-key idea retro arcade cabinet meet-and-play this Friday? we can bring a couple of joysticks, a mini JAMMA board, and run high score challenges on the mezz. 7pm start, casual prizes.
mora: Love it. I can bring my tiny 2-player arcade cabinet (works on 12V) + a box of extra buttons and joysticks.
kai: I'm up for high score duty. Can we do a token jar for charity? small donations to local food bank. :coin: :heart:
lee: I have an RGB CRT clone and a small HDMI scaler if anyone wants authentic scanlines. Also an HDMI switch for consoles.
anya: I can sort prizes (stickers & a Steam key) and handle a tiny bracket for competitive rounds. Also volunteer to manage the charity jar.
ryan: poll: Casual freeplay vs structured high-score tournament vs retro co-op marathon. React :one:/:two:/:three:.
patch-bot: Poll created: 1) Casual freeplay 2) High-score tournament 3) Retro co-op marathon. Vote with reactions.
kai: :two: 
mora: :one: and :three: (both sound fun)
lee: :two: for the nostalgia.
ryan: Logistics: setup 6:30, parents room reserved until 9 so noise ok but be mindful. Bring extension cords and surge strips. I'll order pizza if people want. RSVP by Thursday noon. @here
anya: I'll bring labels and a marker to tag controllers. Also making a tiny sign: "Take a token, leave a token" for the charity jar.
kai: I'll handle scorekeeping. thinking 3-minute runs for high-score rounds, then semis/finals on projector.
patch-bot: Calendar event created: "Retro Arcade Night" (root_ts: 2012345678).
mora: Who's bringing coin-op tokens? I have about 30.
lee: I can bring an extra power strip and a small bench for the cabinet.
ryan: Awesome. If you need a guaranteed controller/slot reply here. See you Friday! :joystick:
